close_reason: Committed as 9c212a0: replaced format!() value interpolation with static string in onSuccessSetIsDefault type-check error
description: When onSuccessSetIsDefault resolution fails because the referenced creation id was not found, the error description at crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/addressbook.rs:164-166 includes the raw JSON value via format\!(). This is not a backend error leak (it is client-supplied input echoed back), but the workspace convention elsewhere (e.g. mail-server onSuccessUpdateEmail) uses a static description string for the same pattern rather than interpolating the value. Fix: use a static description like 'onSuccessSetIsDefault referenced an unknown creation id' to match the mail-server canonical pattern. The client already knows what value it sent.
title: onSuccessSetIsDefault error embeds raw JSON value in description
